summary.text: Jennifer Kirkman is the Democratic candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 99 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning a three-way June 2 Democratic primary; she faces incumbent Republican Matthew Rinker.
Her campaign website describes her as a lifelong Iowan, attorney, small business owner and mother.

paragraphs.text: Jennifer Kirkman defeated Jim Beres and Marcques Derby in the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary, according to Ballotpedia.
Her campaign website lists her priorities as stronger public schools, better health care access, a growing economy and opportunity for all.
